sol_country_demand_abs = {
	set_variable = { name = $target$ value = var:$source$ }
	if = { limit = { var:$target$ < 0 } change_variable = { name = $target$ multiply = -1 } }
}

sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_cell_adjustment value = { value = var:sol_m_$pivot$_$col$ multiply = var:sol_demand_elimination_factor } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_$col$ subtract = var:sol_demand_cell_adjustment }
}

sol_country_demand_eliminate_rhs = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_rhs_adjustment value = { value = var:sol_b_$pivot$ multiply = var:sol_demand_elimination_factor } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_b_$row$ subtract = var:sol_demand_rhs_adjustment }
}

sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_demand_elimination_factor value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_$pivot$ divide = var:sol_m_$pivot$_$pivot$ } }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 2 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_cell = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ col = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_eliminate_rhs = { pivot = $pivot$ row = $row$ }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_check_pivot = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_m_$pivot$_$pivot$ target = sol_pivot_abs_$pivot$ }
		if = {
			# Class rows are normalized to nationwide stratum base, so this is a relative threshold.
			limit = { var:sol_pivot_abs_$pivot$ <= 0.0001 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -1 }
		}
	}
}

sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_rhs_adjustment value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_$col$ multiply = var:sol_delta_$col$ } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_delta_$row$ subtract = var:sol_demand_rhs_adjustment }
}

sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_demand_rhs_adjustment value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_$col$ multiply = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_$col$ } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_$row$ subtract = var:sol_demand_rhs_adjustment }
}

sol_country_demand_backsolve_classes = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_4 value = { value = var:sol_b_4 divide = var:sol_m_4_4 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_3 value = var:sol_b_3 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 3 col = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_3 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_3 divide = var:sol_m_3_3 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_2 value = var:sol_b_2 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 2 col = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 2 col = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_2 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_2 divide = var:sol_m_2_2 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_1 value = var:sol_b_1 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 1 col = 4 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 1 col = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_class_cell = { row = 1 col = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_1 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_1 divide = var:sol_m_1_1 } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:$scale$ > 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_1 value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_1 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_2 value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_2 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_3 value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_3 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_m_$row$_4 value = { value = var:sol_m_$row$_4 divide = var:$scale$ } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_b_$row$ value = { value = var:sol_b_$row$ divide = var:$scale$ } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_matrix = {
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = { row = 1 scale = sol_country_baseline_spending_nobles }
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = { row = 2 scale = sol_country_baseline_spending_clergy }
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = { row = 3 scale = sol_country_baseline_spending_burghers }
	sol_country_demand_normalize_working_class_row = { row = 4 scale = sol_country_baseline_lower }
}

sol_country_demand_validate_class = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_country_class_coefficient_$class$ < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -2 }
		}
	}
}

sol_country_demand_validate_class_residual = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_residual_$row$ value = { value = var:sol_country_demand_lhs_$row$ subtract = var:$rhs$ } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_country_class_residual_$row$ target = sol_country_class_residual_abs_$row$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_residual_tolerance_$row$ value = { value = var:$rhs$ multiply = 0.001 add = 0.01 } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 var:sol_country_class_residual_abs_$row$ > var:sol_country_class_residual_tolerance_$row$ }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -7 }
	}
}

	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_3 multiply = 0.001 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_3 multiply = 0.001 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_3 > var:sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_3 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_3 value = var:sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_3 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_3 > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_gate_possible value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_3 > var:sol_approx_cached_worst_raw_error } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_worst_raw_error value = var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_3 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_worst_row value = 3 } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_raw_4 target = sol_approx_raw_abs_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_raw_error_4 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_4 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_4 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_4 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_raw_error_4 multiply = -1 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_4 value = 0.00001 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_4 value = var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_4 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_4 multiply = 0.001 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_4 multiply = 0.001 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_4 multiply = 0.001 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_4 > var:sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_4 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_4 value = var:sol_approx_cached_gate_scale_4 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_4 > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_gate_possible value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_4 > var:sol_approx_cached_worst_raw_error } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_worst_raw_error value = var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_4 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_worst_row value = 4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_total_tolerance value = { value = var:sol_approx_total_target multiply = 0.00001 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_total_tolerance < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_cached_total_tolerance value = 0.00001 } }
}

sol_country_demand_approx_prepare_strategy = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = 0.00001 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = 0.00001 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = 0.00001 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = 0.00001 }
	if = {
		limit = { $strategy$ = 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_raw_abs_1 > var:sol_approx_scale_1 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = var:sol_approx_raw_abs_1 } }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_target_1 target = sol_approx_target_abs_1 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_target_abs_1 > var:sol_approx_scale_1 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = var:sol_approx_target_abs_1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_raw_abs_2 > var:sol_approx_scale_2 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = var:sol_approx_raw_abs_2 } }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_target_2 target = sol_approx_target_abs_2 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_target_abs_2 > var:sol_approx_scale_2 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = var:sol_approx_target_abs_2 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_raw_abs_3 > var:sol_approx_scale_3 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = var:sol_approx_raw_abs_3 } }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_target_3 target = sol_approx_target_abs_3 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_target_abs_3 > var:sol_approx_scale_3 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = var:sol_approx_target_abs_3 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_raw_abs_4 > var:sol_approx_scale_4 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = var:sol_approx_raw_abs_4 } }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_target_4 target = sol_approx_target_abs_4 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_target_abs_4 > var:sol_approx_scale_4 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = var:sol_approx_target_abs_4 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $strategy$ = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_1 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_1 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_1 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = 0.00001 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_2 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_2 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_2 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_2 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = 0.00001 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_3 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_3 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_3 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_3 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = 0.00001 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_4 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_4 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_4 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_4 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = 0.00001 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $strategy$ = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_target_1 target = sol_approx_scale_1 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_1 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = 0.00001 } }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_target_2 target = sol_approx_scale_2 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_2 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = 0.00001 } }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_target_3 target = sol_approx_scale_3 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_3 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = 0.00001 } }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_target_4 target = sol_approx_scale_4 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_4 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = 0.00001 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $strategy$ = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_1 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_1 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_1 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_1 value = 0.00001 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_2 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_2 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_2 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_2 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_2 value = 0.00001 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_3 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_3 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_3 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_3 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_3 value = 0.00001 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_4 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_4 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_4 < 0 } change_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_scale_4 < 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_scale_4 value = 0.00001 } }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_approx_assess = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_candidate_valid value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status != 1 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_candidate_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_candidate_valid = 1 var:sol_delta_1 < 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_candidate_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_candidate_valid = 1 var:sol_delta_2 < 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_candidate_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_candidate_valid = 1 var:sol_delta_3 < 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_candidate_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_candidate_valid = 1 var:sol_delta_4 < 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_candidate_valid value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_candidate_valid = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_1 value = { value = var:sol_original_m_1_1 multiply = var:sol_delta_1 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_1 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_1_2 multiply = var:sol_delta_2 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_1 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_1_3 multiply = var:sol_delta_3 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_1 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_1_4 multiply = var:sol_delta_4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_2 value = { value = var:sol_original_m_2_1 multiply = var:sol_delta_1 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_2 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_2_2 multiply = var:sol_delta_2 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_2 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_2_3 multiply = var:sol_delta_3 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_2 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_2_4 multiply = var:sol_delta_4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_3 value = { value = var:sol_original_m_3_1 multiply = var:sol_delta_1 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_3 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_3_2 multiply = var:sol_delta_2 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_3 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_3_3 multiply = var:sol_delta_3 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_3 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_3_4 multiply = var:sol_delta_4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_4 value = { value = var:sol_original_m_4_1 multiply = var:sol_delta_1 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_4 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_4_2 multiply = var:sol_delta_2 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_4 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_4_3 multiply = var:sol_delta_3 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_4 add = { value = var:sol_original_m_4_4 multiply = var:sol_delta_4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_total_actual value = { value = var:sol_approx_prediction_1 add = var:sol_approx_prediction_2 add = var:sol_approx_prediction_3 add = var:sol_approx_prediction_4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_candidate_total_residual value = { value = var:sol_approx_total_actual subtract = var:sol_approx_total_target } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_candidate_total_residual target = sol_approx_candidate_total_residual_abs }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_total_tolerance value = var:sol_approx_cached_total_tolerance }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_candidate_valid = 1 var:sol_approx_candidate_total_residual_abs > var:sol_approx_total_tolerance } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_candidate_valid value = 0 } }
	# Wide gate: only the worst raw row may not worsen, and mean improvement ratio must be positive.
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_gate value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_objective value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_ratio value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_absolute value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_error value = { value = var:sol_approx_prediction_1 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_1 } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_prediction_error target = sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_raw_error_1 value = var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_improvement_1 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_error_1 subtract = var:sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_1 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_absolute add = var:sol_approx_improvement_1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_ratio_1 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_raw_error_1 > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_ratio_1 value = { value = var:sol_approx_improvement_1 divide = var:sol_approx_raw_error_1 } } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_ratio add = var:sol_approx_ratio_1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_error_ratio_1 value = { value = var:sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_1 divide = var:sol_approx_scale_1 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_objective add = { value = var:sol_approx_error_ratio_1 multiply = var:sol_approx_error_ratio_1 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_error value = { value = var:sol_approx_prediction_2 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_2 } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_prediction_error target = sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_2 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_raw_error_2 value = var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_2 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_improvement_2 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_error_2 subtract = var:sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_2 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_absolute add = var:sol_approx_improvement_2 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_ratio_2 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_raw_error_2 > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_ratio_2 value = { value = var:sol_approx_improvement_2 divide = var:sol_approx_raw_error_2 } } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_ratio add = var:sol_approx_ratio_2 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_error_ratio_2 value = { value = var:sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_2 divide = var:sol_approx_scale_2 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_objective add = { value = var:sol_approx_error_ratio_2 multiply = var:sol_approx_error_ratio_2 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_error value = { value = var:sol_approx_prediction_3 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_3 } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_prediction_error target = sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_3 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_raw_error_3 value = var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_3 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_improvement_3 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_error_3 subtract = var:sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_3 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_absolute add = var:sol_approx_improvement_3 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_ratio_3 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_raw_error_3 > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_ratio_3 value = { value = var:sol_approx_improvement_3 divide = var:sol_approx_raw_error_3 } } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_ratio add = var:sol_approx_ratio_3 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_error_ratio_3 value = { value = var:sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_3 divide = var:sol_approx_scale_3 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_objective add = { value = var:sol_approx_error_ratio_3 multiply = var:sol_approx_error_ratio_3 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_prediction_error value = { value = var:sol_approx_prediction_4 subtract = var:sol_approx_target_4 } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_approx_prediction_error target = sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_raw_error_4 value = var:sol_approx_cached_raw_error_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_improvement_4 value = { value = var:sol_approx_raw_error_4 subtract = var:sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_4 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_absolute add = var:sol_approx_improvement_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_ratio_4 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_raw_error_4 > 0.00001 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_ratio_4 value = { value = var:sol_approx_improvement_4 divide = var:sol_approx_raw_error_4 } } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_ratio add = var:sol_approx_ratio_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_error_ratio_4 value = { value = var:sol_approx_candidate_abs_error_4 divide = var:sol_approx_scale_4 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_approx_objective add = { value = var:sol_approx_error_ratio_4 multiply = var:sol_approx_error_ratio_4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_ratio value = { value = var:sol_approx_average_ratio divide = 4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_average_absolute value = { value = var:sol_approx_average_absolute divide = 4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_improvement value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_tolerance value = 0.00001 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_worst_row = 1 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_improvement value = var:sol_approx_improvement_1 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_tolerance value = var:sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_1 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_worst_row = 2 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_improvement value = var:sol_approx_improvement_2 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_tolerance value = var:sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_2 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_worst_row = 3 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_improvement value = var:sol_approx_improvement_3 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_tolerance value = var:sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_3 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_cached_worst_row = 4 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_improvement value = var:sol_approx_improvement_4 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_tolerance value = var:sol_approx_cached_gate_tolerance_4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_approx_worst_gate_margin value = { value = var:sol_approx_worst_improvement add = var:sol_approx_worst_tolerance } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_candidate_valid = 1 var:sol_approx_average_ratio > 0 var:sol_approx_worst_gate_margin >= 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_approx_gate value = 1 } }
	}
	}
	if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_candidate_valid = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_approx_gate = 1 }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_approx_objective < var:sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_$strategy$ }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_factor_1_$strategy$ value = var:sol_delta_1 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_factor_2_$strategy$ value = var:sol_delta_2 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_factor_3_$strategy$ value = var:sol_delta_3 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_factor_4_$strategy$ value = var:sol_delta_4 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_$strategy$ value = var:sol_approx_objective }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_$strategy$ value = var:sol_approx_gate }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_$strategy$ value = var:sol_approx_average_ratio }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_$strategy$ value = var:sol_approx_average_absolute }
			}
		}
	}
}

sol_country_demand_select_approx_strategy = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_strategy value = $strategy$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_ratio value = var:sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_$strategy$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_absolute value = var:sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_$strategy$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_objective value = var:sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_$strategy$ }
}

sol_country_demand_solve_approximation = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_strategy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_gate_possible value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_objective value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_ratio value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_absolute value = -999999 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_exact_status != 1 } sol_country_demand_approx_prepare_country = yes }
	# Exact success is adopted directly; only exact failures reach approximation.
	# Four CMF toggles control exact and approx for human/AI independently.
	# Human approximation: strict no-worsen vertex sweep (strategy 8).
	# AI approximation: proportional-fast (strategy 6), reuses the candidate assessor.
	# gate_possible is the prefilter: with every raw row already inside
	# tolerance there is nothing for either path to improve, so both skip.
	# Both sides now run the same strict no-worsen vertex sweep. The old AI
	# proportional_fast pass adopted a candidate for only 4.2% of eligible
	# countries against the vertex sweep's 90.7% on the same save, and its
	# median scaled L1 barely moved off raw (0.335 vs raw 0.343, vertex
	# 0.114), so a single shared path is both simpler and strictly better.
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_exact_status != 1 var:sol_country_demand_gate_possible = 1 var:sol_country_demand_anchor_count > 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable_map = cmm }
					AND = { is_human = yes has_global_variable = sol_solver_human_approx_enabled }
					AND = { is_ai = yes has_global_variable = sol_solver_ai_approx_enabled }
				}
			}
			sol_country_demand_run_vertex_selector = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_exact_status = 1 }
		# Exact factors are already validated; adopt them without approximation or gate filtering.
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_strategy value = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_objective value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_ratio value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_absolute value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_selected_strategy <= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_1 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_2 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_3 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_class_coefficient_4 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -8 }
	}
}

# Relative residual for one row: |sum_c original_m[row][c] * f[c] - t[row]| / |t[row]|.
# A negligible target contributes zero, matching the offline reference.
sol_vertex_row_metric = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_pred value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_term value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_1 multiply = var:sol_vertex_f_1 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_vertex_pred add = var:sol_vertex_term }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_term value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_2 multiply = var:sol_vertex_f_2 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_vertex_pred add = var:sol_vertex_term }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_term value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_3 multiply = var:sol_vertex_f_3 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_vertex_pred add = var:sol_vertex_term }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_term value = { value = var:sol_original_m_$row$_4 multiply = var:sol_vertex_f_4 } }
	change_variable = { name = sol_vertex_pred add = var:sol_vertex_term }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_resid value = { value = var:sol_vertex_pred subtract = var:$target$ } }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_vertex_resid target = sol_vertex_resid_abs }
	sol_country_demand_abs = { source = $target$ target = sol_vertex_target_abs }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_rel_$row$ value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_vertex_target_abs > 0.00001 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_rel_$row$ value = { value = var:sol_vertex_resid_abs divide = var:sol_vertex_target_abs } }
	}
}

# Fills sol_vertex_l1 and sol_vertex_linf from sol_vertex_f_1..4.
sol_vertex_metrics = {
	sol_vertex_row_metric = { row = 1 target = sol_country_demand_target_nobles }
	sol_vertex_row_metric = { row = 2 target = sol_country_demand_target_clergy }
	sol_vertex_row_metric = { row = 3 target = sol_country_demand_target_burghers }
	sol_vertex_row_metric = { row = 4 target = sol_country_demand_target_lower }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_l1 value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_vertex_l1 add = var:sol_vertex_rel_1 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_vertex_l1 add = var:sol_vertex_rel_2 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_vertex_l1 add = var:sol_vertex_rel_3 }
	change_variable = { name = sol_vertex_l1 add = var:sol_vertex_rel_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_l1 value = { value = var:sol_vertex_l1 divide = 4 } }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_linf value = var:sol_vertex_rel_1 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_vertex_rel_2 > var:sol_vertex_linf } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_linf value = var:sol_vertex_rel_2 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_vertex_rel_3 > var:sol_vertex_linf } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_linf value = var:sol_vertex_rel_3 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_vertex_rel_4 > var:sol_vertex_linf } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_linf value = var:sol_vertex_rel_4 } }
}

# Caches the raw (all factors = 1) metrics that form the hard constraint,
# and seeds the incumbent with raw itself so a fallback is always available.
sol_vertex_init = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_f_1 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_f_2 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_f_3 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_f_4 value = 1 }
	sol_vertex_metrics = yes
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_raw_l1 value = var:sol_vertex_l1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_raw_linf value = var:sol_vertex_linf }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_l1 value = var:sol_vertex_l1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_linf value = var:sol_vertex_linf }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_f_1 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_f_2 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_f_3 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_f_4 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_found value = 0 }
}

# Evaluates sol_vertex_f_1..4 and adopts it when it beats the incumbent.
# Hard constraint: neither scaled metric may exceed its raw value.
# Primary: lower scaled L1. Tie band: within 1% of the incumbent L1,
# decided on scaled L-infinity instead.
sol_vertex_consider = {
	sol_vertex_metrics = yes
	set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_ok value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_vertex_l1 > var:sol_vertex_raw_l1 } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_ok value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_vertex_linf > var:sol_vertex_raw_linf } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_ok value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_vertex_ok = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_tie value = { value = var:sol_vertex_best_l1 multiply = 0.01 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_take value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_l1_low value = { value = var:sol_vertex_best_l1 subtract = var:sol_vertex_tie } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_l1_high value = { value = var:sol_vertex_best_l1 add = var:sol_vertex_tie } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_vertex_l1 < var:sol_vertex_l1_low }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_take value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sol_vertex_l1 < var:sol_vertex_l1_high var:sol_vertex_linf < var:sol_vertex_best_linf }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_take value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_vertex_take = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_l1 value = var:sol_vertex_l1 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_linf value = var:sol_vertex_linf }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_f_1 value = var:sol_vertex_f_1 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_f_2 value = var:sol_vertex_f_2 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_f_3 value = var:sol_vertex_f_3 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_best_f_4 value = var:sol_vertex_f_4 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_found value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

sol_vertex_case_1 = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_1 value = var:sol_original_m_1_1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_2 value = var:sol_original_m_1_2 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_3 value = var:sol_original_m_1_3 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_1_4 value = var:sol_original_m_1_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_1 value = var:sol_country_demand_target_nobles }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_1 value = var:sol_original_m_2_1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_2 value = var:sol_original_m_2_2 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_3 value = var:sol_original_m_2_3 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_2_4 value = var:sol_original_m_2_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_2 value = var:sol_country_demand_target_clergy }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_1 value = var:sol_original_m_3_1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_2 value = var:sol_original_m_3_2 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_3 value = var:sol_original_m_3_3 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_3_4 value = var:sol_original_m_3_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_3 value = var:sol_country_demand_target_burghers }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_1 value = var:sol_original_m_4_1 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_2 value = var:sol_original_m_4_2 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_3 value = var:sol_original_m_4_3 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_m_4_4 value = var:sol_original_m_4_4 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_b_4 value = var:sol_country_demand_target_lower }
	sol_country_demand_check_kkt_pivot = { pivot = 1 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_kkt_pivot = { pivot = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 2 row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 2 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_kkt_pivot = { pivot = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 3 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_kkt_pivot = { pivot = 4 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_4 value = var:sol_b_4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_4 value = { value = var:sol_delta_4 divide = var:sol_m_4_4 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_3 value = var:sol_b_3 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = 3 col = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_3 value = { value = var:sol_delta_3 divide = var:sol_m_3_3 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_2 value = var:sol_b_2 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = 2 col = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = 2 col = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_2 value = { value = var:sol_delta_2 divide = var:sol_m_2_2 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_1 value = var:sol_b_1 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = 1 col = 2 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = 1 col = 3 }
		sol_country_demand_backsolve_cell = { row = 1 col = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_1 value = { value = var:sol_delta_1 divide = var:sol_m_1_1 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_neg value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_delta_1 < 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_neg value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_delta_2 < 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_neg value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_delta_3 < 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_neg value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_delta_4 < 0 } set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_neg value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sol_vertex_neg = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_f_1 value = var:sol_delta_1 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_f_2 value = var:sol_delta_2 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_f_3 value = var:sol_delta_3 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_vertex_f_4 value = var:sol_delta_4 }
			sol_vertex_consider = yes
		}
	}
}

	set_variable = { name = sol_b_4 value = var:sol_country_demand_target_clergy }
	sol_country_demand_check_kkt_pivot = { pivot = 1 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 1 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_kkt_pivot = { pivot = 2 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 2 row = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 2 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_kkt_pivot = { pivot = 3 }
	sol_country_demand_eliminate_row = { pivot = 3 row = 4 }
	sol_country_demand_check_kkt_pivot = { pivot = 4 }
